**Diontae Johnson  
Wide Receiver  
Toledo  
5-10, 183  
Ruskin, Fla.  
Lennard High School  
3rd Round â 66th Overall**

**CAREER NOTES**  
Totaled 137 receptions for 2,276 yards and 24 touchdowns in 38 games played at Toledoâ¦ranks fifth in school history in touchdown receptionsâ¦returned 79 kickoffs (1,849 yards) for a 23.4 return average and two touchdowns and 17 punt returns (243 yards) with two return scores.

**2018 SEASON**  
Garnered MAC Special Teams Player of the Year honorsâ¦first-team All-MAC selection as a wide receiver and punt returner and second-team as a kickoff returnerâ¦led offense in receptions (43) and receiving yards (663) with seven touchdown catches, along with a punt return and kickoff return for a touchdownâ¦caught six passes for 119 yards and two touchdowns vs. Miami (Fla.)
